units.source_text: ——以宪兵为首，人群争先恐后地从石阶跑上去，急忙跑到两具尸体的旁边。

en.t: With the military police leading the way, the crowd rushed up the stone steps in a scramble, hurrying to the side of the two corpses.

units.source_text: 我对此置之不理，依然纹丝不动地隐藏在枫树的蔽荫处。

en.t: I paid no attention to this and remained hidden, utterly motionless, in the shade of the maple tree.

units.source_text: 白色的木架重重叠叠，纵横交错地耸立在我的上方。

en.t: White wooden scaffolding rose above me in layer upon layer, crisscrossing in every direction.

units.source_text: 从上面传来了轻微而杂乱无章的踩在游廊地板上的皮鞋声。

en.t: From above came the faint, irregular sound of leather shoes stepping on the floor of the gallery.

units.source_text: 两三道交错的手电筒的光束，超过栅栏直射在枫树梢上。

en.t: Two or three crossing beams of flashlight light shot over the railing and straight onto the tips of the maple branches.
